article_content: (CNN) -- A U.S. drone strike on Wednesday morning killed at least 10 militants and injured 14 near the Afghan-Pakistani border, a Pakistani military official said. The attack targeted militants in Afghanistan's Nangarhar province, the official said, speaking on condition of anonymity. It wasn't immediately clear which militant group or groups were targeted. Haroon Zarghoon, a spokesman for an armed resistance movement, Hizb-e-Islami Afghanistan, said his group was not affected. But, citing his group's fighters in the region, he said one attack was in the Afghan province's Nazyan district, 1 to 2 miles (2 to 3 kilometers) from the border with Pakistan. Targets included smugglers who had been using an alternate route for bringing goods to Pakistan on foot, Zarghoon said. One strike occurred in Pakistan's Tirah Valley, according to residents in the area. However, the Pakistani military official maintained that the attacks happened only in Afghanistan. Afghanistan's Nangarhar province borders Pakistan's loosely governed tribal region. A few hundred miles to the southwest, two suicide bombers and three other insurgents attacked a border police post in Afghanistan's southern Kandahar province on Wednesday evening, killing three police officers and injuring five other people, Interior Ministry spokesman Sediq Sediqi said. The Taliban claimed responsibility for the attack, Taliban spokesman Qari Yusuf Ahmadi said. The two suicide bombers wore women's burqas, Sediqi said. After they blew themselves up, police killed the other three attackers, he said. The attack happened around 8 p.m. in Kandahar's Spin Boldak district near the border with Pakistan. CNN's Aliza Kassim and Masoud Popalzai and journalist Saleem Mehsud contributed to this report.

Útok mířil na ozbrojence v afghánské provincii Nangarhar, řekl představitel pod podmínkou anonymity. Nebylo ihned jasné, na kterou ozbrojenou skupinu nebo skupiny útok mířil. Haroon Zarghoon, mluvčí ozbrojeného odbojového hnutí Hizb-e-Islami Afghanistan, řekl, že jeho skupina nebyla postižena. Ale s odvoláním na své bojovníky v regionu řekl, že jeden útok byl v okrese Nazyan v afghánské provincii, 1 až 2 míle (2 až 3 kilometry) od hranice s Pákistánem. Cílem byli pašeráci, kteří používali alternativní cestu pro přepravu zboží do Pákistánu pěšky, řekl Zarghoon. Jedno bombardování se odehrálo v pákistánském údolí Tirah, podle obyvatel oblasti. Stovky kilometrů jihozápadně dva sebevražední atentátníci a tři další povstalci zaútočili na hraniční policejní stanici v jižní afghánské provincii Kandahár ve středu večer, přičemž zabili tři policisty a zranili pět dalších lidí, řekl mluvčí ministerstva vnitra Sediq Sediqi. Taliban si čin přisvojil, řekl mluvčí Talibanu Qari Yusuf Ahmadi. Oba sebevražední atentátníci měli na sobě ženské burky, řekl Sediqi. Po jejich sebevražedném útoku policie zabila zbývající tři útočníky, řekl. Útok se odehrál kolem 20.00 v okrese Spin Boldak v Kandaháru nedaleko hranice s Pákistánem. K příspěvku přispěli Aliza Kassim a Masoud Popalzai z CNN a novinář Saleem Mehsud.

article_content: By Anthony Bond. UPDATED: 05:08 EST, 26 January 2012. Guilty: 'Tragic figure' Leonard Watters, pictured at an earlier hearing, apologised to Louis Walsh for the false claims. An unemployed dance teacher has been sentenced to six months in jail for falsely accusing X Factor judge Louis Walsh of groping him in a nightclub. Leonard Watters pleaded guilty to making two false reports to Irish police that the pop music mogul sexually assaulted him in Dublin nightspot Krystle last April. The 24-year-old father-of-two from Navan, Co Meath, who was described in court as a Walter Mitty-type character, had apologised publicly to Mr Walsh at the city's District Court. Passing sentence, Judge Dermot Dempsey immediately granted Watters bail to appeal against the decision, on condition that he lodged 100 Euros in cash with the court. Pleading for a non-custodial sentence, Watters' solicitor, Cahir O'Higgins, said his client was a tragic figure whose life had been a litany of disasters from an early age. Watters was now a laughing stock and a joke, and had been treated as a pariah in his own community, he told the court. 'For ever and a day, he will be known as the guy who accused Louis Walsh in the wrong,' he said. At a previous hearing, Watters apologised to Mr Walsh. 'I would like to sincerely apologise to Mr Louis Walsh for all the trouble I put him through. The allegation was false,' he said. Detective Inspector Michael Cryan previously told the court the defendant had claimed the assault happened on Saturday, April 9, after Westlife had performed in Dublin's 02. False allegations: Leonard Watters pleaded guilty to making two false reports to Irish police that pop music mogul Louis Walsh, pictured, sexually assaulted him in a Dublin nightclub. Watters and Walsh had been socialising in a pub and travelled to Krystle together, he said, but at about 4am to 4.30am Watters approached a Garda officer on patrol outside the celebrity spot on Harcourt Street alleging he had been sexually assaulted by Walsh. The defendant was taken to Mountjoy Garda Station where he made the same allegation, before being examined at a sexual assault unit—which revealed bruising in his genital area. More than two months later, on June 20, he showed investigators the toilet in the nightclub where he alleged the offence took place and made his first formal statement. Within days Mr Walsh was interviewed under caution and denied the allegation, added Det Insp Cryan. Watters made a second false statement on June 27 and was shown CCTV from the nightclub. 'It became obvious the CCTV did not support his allegations,' he added. When Watters was arrested at his home on June 28 he admitted Walsh did not sexually assault him. 'He continued to claim he was sexually assaulted in the toilets but that Louis Walsh did not do it,' the Detective added. Watters has previous convictions for breaching a barring order under domestic violence laws and driving offences. Walsh became a household name in 2004 when he was announced as a judge on X Factor and is the only remaining member of the original panel. He has managed a number of groups and performers, including boy bands Boyzone and Westlife.

article_content: In a swift decision, a jury found Christopher Vaughn guilty of the brutal murder of his wife and three children. The tragic incident occurred in 2007 when Vaughn shot his family members in their SUV while they were en route to a water park. Vaughn, a 37-year-old computer specialist from suburban Chicago, remained stoic as the verdict was announced. Outside the courtroom, the victims' family members were overcome with emotion, crying and embracing each other. Vaughn's motive, according to prosecutors, was his desire for a new life in the Canadian wilderness, free from the responsibilities of family life. He had been planning this escape, compiling survival guides and posting online about his dreams of building a cabin and living off the grid in the Yukon. Prosecutors described the crime as an atrocity, highlighting the cold-blooded nature of Vaughn's actions. Although Vaughn was eligible for the death penalty at the time of the crime, Illinois had since abolished capital punishment. As a result, he now faces a life sentence without the possibility of parole. The sentencing is scheduled for November 26. The prosecution presented a chilling timeline of events: just after 5 am, Vaughn pulled the family SUV off the highway, shot his wife Kimberly, and then his children Abigayle, Cassandra, and Blake. Prosecutors argued that Vaughn saw his family as obstacles to his dream of a solitary life in the wilderness. Defense attorney George Lenard countered that it was Kimberly Vaughn who committed the murders and then took her own life, driven by marital issues and the effects of antidepressant medication. However, prosecutors dismissed this argument, citing witnesses who described Kimberly as upbeat and cheerful shortly before the tragedy. Throughout the trial, Vaughn showed little emotion, even when confronted with graphic crime scene photos. His defense claimed that Kimberly's actions were a twisted act of mercy, believing her children would be better off with her in heaven. The prosecution refuted this, questioning how Kimberly could have accurately shot her children but only grazed her husband.

article_content: In a packed courtroom, the murder trial of Christopher Vaughn, accused of killing his wife and three children, began with the display of gruesome crime scene photographs. Vaughn, from Oswego, Illinois, faces first-degree murder charges for the deaths that occurred on June 14, 2007. Prosecutors allege he killed his family to move to a remote area in Canada alone. The trial opened with Officer Steve Weiss of the Channahon Police Department describing the discovery of the Vaughn family's SUV containing the bodies. Paramedic Ryan Jandura later testified that Vaughn's daughter Abigayle was found clutching a stuffed animal and a Harry Potter book. Vaughn, dressed in a white shirt, dark pants, and a tan jacket, showed little emotion as the images were displayed. The jury, comprising eight men and four women, appeared visibly upset. Vaughn's defense team objected multiple times, arguing that the images were shown for too long. Kimberly Vaughn's mother, Susan Phillips, took the stand and described the heart-wrenching moment she saw her daughter's body on a TV news report. Assistant State's Attorney Debbie Mills claimed Vaughn wanted to eliminate his family to move to Canada, having visited the country a month prior to plan his move. The prosecution portrayed Vaughn as an 'eccentric dreamer' who spent heavily at gentlemen's clubs. Vaughn, 37, was arrested at a funeral home in suburban St. Louis just before his family's memorial service. He pleaded not guilty, insisting his wife was responsible for the killings. The trial, expected to last four to six weeks, gained attention partly due to the family's feature in a Chicago Sun-Times real estate article. Prosecutors initially sought the death penalty, now abolished in Illinois. If convicted, Vaughn faces life imprisonment. Evidence includes a magazine article about staging crime scenes and making deaths appear like suicides, found at Vaughn's home. Court records reveal Vaughn visited a shooting range the night before the murders and was the beneficiary of his wife's $1 million life insurance policy. An exotic dancer Vaughn visited days before the killings may testify. Vaughn's defense is expected to focus on Kimberly Vaughn's health, including her use of an anti-seizure drug that can increase suicidal behavior risks. Vaughn, a computer security consultant, claimed his wife shot him before killing the children and herself. He had superficial gunshot wounds. The children were each shot twice, and Kimberly Vaughn once under the chin. Vaughn has been held without bond in Will County.

Vaughn z Oswega v Illinois čelí obvinění z vraždy prvního stupně za smrt, ke které došlo 14. června 2007. Žalobci tvrdí, že zabil svoji rodinu, aby se mohl sám přestěhovat do odlehlé oblasti Kanady. Žalobci původně usilovali o trest smrti, který byl v Illinois nyní zrušen. Pokud bude Vaughn usvědčen, hrozí mu doživotní vězení. Důkazy zahrnují článek z časopisu o inscenování scén zločinu a zfalšování sebevraždy, nalezený v Vaughnově domě. Soudní záznamy odhalily, že Vaughn navštívil střelnici večer před vraždami a byl beneficientem pojistky na život své manželky ve výši 1 milionu dolarů. article_content: Two men, aged 24 and 25, have been arrested in connection with the disappearance of 17-year-old Adam Pickup, a police spokeswoman confirmed. The arrests come after Adam failed to return home following a night out on Saturday. Adam was last seen with friends in Manchester city centre before leaving Fab Cafe on Portland Street around 3:20 AM. CCTV footage shows him walking along Oxford Street at approximately 3:30 AM, where he appears to be speaking with a man and a woman. Adam is described as white, 6ft 2in tall, slim with mousey brown hair. He was wearing a maroon long-sleeved collared shirt, black jeans, and black leather Nike trainers with white soles. The man and woman he was seen with are described as white, both with dark hair and dark clothing. The man was wearing glasses and a blue scarf. A Greater Manchester Police (GMP) spokeswoman stated, 'Police have arrested two men as part of their inquiries to locate Adam Pickup. They are currently in police custody for questioning. Inquiries are ongoing to find Adam, and police continue to appeal to anyone who may have seen him or knows of his whereabouts.' Chief Superintendent Chris Sykes emphasized that the investigation is still being treated as a missing person case and urged the public not to speculate. Superintendent John Berry expressed concern for Adam's welfare and appealed for information regarding his movements or whereabouts. Anyone with information about Adam's movements or whereabouts should contact police on 0161 856 9675, or the independent charity Crimestoppers, anonymously, on 0800 555 111.

Zatčení následovalo poté, co Adam nepřišel domů po noční zábavě v sobotu. Adam byl naposledy viděn s přáteli v centru Manchesteru, než opustil Fab Cafe na Portland Street kolem 3:20 ráno. Záznam z bezpečnostní kamery ho ukazuje, jak kráčí po Oxford Street kolem 3:30 ráno, kde zdánlivě mluví s mužem a ženou. Adam je popisován jako bílý, 6 stop a 2 palce vysoký, štíhlý s hnědými vlasy myšky. Měl na sobě bordóovou dlouhérukavou košili s límcem, černé džínové kalhoty a černé kožené boty Nike s bílými podrážkami. Muž a žena, se kterými byl viděn, jsou popisováni jako bílí, oba s tmavými vlasy a tmavým oblečením. Muž měl na sobě brýle a modrý šátek. Mluvčí policie Velkého Manchesteru (GMP) uvedla: 'Policie zatkla dva muže v rámci vyšetřování zmizení Adama Pickupa. Jsou nyní v policejní vazbě k výslechu. Vyšetřování pokračuje a policie stále žádá o informace od každého, kto Adama mohl vidět nebo ví o jeho pobytu.' Šéf superintendant Chris Sykes zdůraznil, že vyšetřování je stále považováno za případ zmizelé osoby a vyzval veřejnost, aby se neoddávala spekulacím. Superintendant John Berry vyjádřil obavy o Adamově blahobytu a žádal o informace o jeho pohybech nebo pobytu. Kdokoli, kdo má informace o Adamových pohybech nebo pobytu, by se měl obrátit na policii na čísle 0161 856 9675 nebo na nezávislou charitativní organizaci Crimestoppers anonymně na čísle 0800 555 111.

article_content: Los Angeles (CNN) -- A police officer removed a sheet covering Whitney Houston's naked corpse and remarked, 'Damn, she's still looking good, huh?' according to another officer at the scene. The accusation against the Beverly Hills Police detective was revealed in a labor dispute filing made last week by Brian Weir, who was the senior patrol sergeant called to Houston's hotel room after she was found dead in a bathtub on February 11, 2012. Weir claims the Beverly Hills police chief and others retaliated against him when he complained about the alleged actions of Det. Sgt. Terry Nutall at the death scene on the fourth floor of the Beverly Hilton Hotel. 'We will be looking into the allegations made in this claim, but we were not aware of any inappropriate behavior or comments made by any officer at the scene,' Beverly Hills Police spokesman Lt. Lincoln Hoshino told CNN Wednesday. No formal complaint was ever filed with the police department by Weir or anyone else, Hoshino said. 'How can we retaliate against him for reporting misconduct if we weren't aware of any misconduct?' he said. Houston drowned face down in a hotel tub of 'extremely hot water' about 12 inches deep, the final autopsy report on the singer's death said. The Los Angeles County coroner ruled that Houston's death on the eve of the 2012 Grammy Awards was an accidental drowning with the 'effects of atherosclerotic heart disease and cocaine use' as contributing factors. Weir's complaint, filed on September 11 with California's labor department, said he covered Houston's body with a sheet 'to prevent contamination or potential DNA and other potential evidence on the body' and to 'preserve the dignity of the remains.' It said that Nutall -- who was assigned to investigate fraud, forgery and auto burglaries -- 'knelt beside and leaned over the decedent, removed the sheet and/or other covering from the body of the decedent to an area below the pubic region of the decedent's body and came in close proximity to touching the body of the decedent while making inappropriate comments to the effect and substance that the decedent 'looked attractive for a woman of her age and current state' and 'Damn, she's still looking good, huh?' Nutall 'did properly respond to the scene,' the police spokesman said, clarifying that his actions were deemed appropriate. 'It is appropriate for a responding detective sergeant to briefly examine the body upon arriving to a scene like that.' Weir, who had been in the 'coveted positions' of sergeant with the SWAT and K-9 units, claims he told Beverly Hills officials about the incident, which he said he believed violated state and federal laws. After complaining to his superiors and others in the Beverly Hills government, Weir was removed from his 'coveted positions'. He was also denied promotion to other positions, removed from supervisory duties, denied special pay, denied training, harassed and ostracized, given inappropriate and harassing comments and/or documents, and subjected to conduct undermining his authority as a superior, the filing said. He also lost overtime pay, the filing alleged. The complaint accuses Police Chief David Snowden, Capt. Tony Lee and Nutall -- who has since been promoted to lieutenant -- of taking specific 'reprisal actions, including acts of intimidation, restraint, coercion, discrimination, punitive, and/or disciplinary actions' against Weir. Weir's lawyer Christopher Brizzolara is demanding economic and non-economic damages for his client, who has suffered damage to his law enforcement career and emotional stress. Houston was last seen alive by her personal assistant in her Beverly Hilton room at about 3 p.m. that Saturday, the autopsy report said. The assistant left to run errands after telling Houston to take a bath in preparation for a pre-Grammy Awards party at the hotel that night, it said. When the assistant returned to the locked room at 3:35 p.m., she found Houston 'lying face down in the bathtub filled with water, unresponsive.' 'The assistant called for her bodyguard, and together they pulled the decedent out of the bathtub,' the report said. When paramedics arrived about 10 minutes later, they moved Houston to the living room floor. At 3:55 p.m., 20 minutes after she was found by the assistant, paramedics concluded she was dead, the report said. Houston won six Grammys and sold 170 million albums, singles and videos over her career. In recent years, the singer's accomplishments were overtaken by her struggles with drug addiction. CNN's Rachel Wells and Jennifer Wolfe contributed to this report.
translated_content: Los Angeles (CNN) -- Policista odhalil tělo Whitney Houston a poznamenal: 'Čert, stále vypadá dobře, co?' podle dalšího policisty na místě. Obvinění proti detektivovi z Beverly Hills Police bylo odhaleno v žalobě podané minulý týden Brianem Weirem, který byl povolán do hotelového pokoje Whitney Houston poté, co byla nalezena mrtvá ve vaně 11. února 2012. Weir tvrdí, že šéf policie Beverly Hills a další se proti němu pomstili, když si stěžoval na údajné jednání detektiva Terrence Nutalla na místě smrti na čtvrtém patře hotelu Beverly Hilton. 'Budeme šetřit námitky uvedené v této stížnosti, ale nevěděli jsme o žádném nevhodném chování nebo poznámkách kterékoli důstojníka na místě,' řekl mluvčí policie Beverly Hills poručík Lincoln Hoshino v úterý CNN. Žádná formální stížnost nebyla nikdy podána na policejním oddělení Weirem ani nikým jiným, řekl Hoshino. 'Jak mohli pomstít za nahlášení neslušného chování, když jsme o něm nevěděli?' řekl. Houstonová se utopila tváří dolů ve vaně s 'extrémně horkou vodou' o hloubce asi 12 palců, uvádí závěrečná pitevní zpráva o smrti zpěvačky. Koroner okresu Los Angeles určil, že smrt Whitney Houston na předvečer udílení cen Grammy v roce 2012 byla nešťastnou událostí s 'vlivem aterosklerotické srdeční choroby a užívání kokainu' jako přispívajícími faktory. Weirova stížnost, podaná 11. září u pracovního úřadu státu Kalifornie, uvádí, že přikryl Houstonové tělo prostěradlem 'aby se zabránilo kontaminaci nebo potenciální DNA a jiným potenciálním důkazům na těle' a 'aby se zachovala důstojnost ostatků.' Uvádí, že Nutall -- který byl pověřen vyšetřováním podvodů, padělání a krádeží aut -- 'klekal vedle a naklonil se nad zesnulou, odhalil prostěradlo a/nebo jiné pokrývky z těla zesnulé do oblasti pod veřejnou oblastí těla zesnulé a přiblížil se ke doteku těla zesnulé, zatímco dělal nevhodné poznámky o tom, že zesnulá 'vypadala atraktivně pro ženu jejího věku a současného stavu' a 'Čert, stále vypadá dobře, co?' Nutall 'správně zareagoval na místo činu', řekl mluvčí policie a upřesnil, že jeho jednání bylo považováno za vhodné. 'Je vhodné, aby vyšetřující detektiv seržant stručně prohlédl tělo po příjezdu na takové místo.' Weir, který byl v 'žádaných pozicích' seržanta u jednotek SWAT a K-9, tvrdí, že řekl úředníkům z Beverly Hills o incidentu, který podle něj porušil státní a federální zákony. Po stížnosti na jeho nadřízené a další v Beverly Hills vládě byl Weir odstraněn z jeho 'žádaných pozic'. Byl také odmítnut povýšením na jiné pozice, odstraněn z dozorčích povinností, odmítnut zvláštní plat, odmítnut výcvik, šikanován a vyloučen, dávaly mu nevhodné a obtěžující poznámky a/nebo dokumenty a byl vystaven jednání, které podkopávalo jeho autoritu jako nadřízeného, uvádí žaloba. Ztratil také přesčasy, tvrdí žaloba. Stížnost obviňuje policejního šéfa Davida Snowdena, kapitána Tonyho Lee a Nutalla -- který byl od té doby povýšen na poručíka -- z podnikání specifických 'odvetných akcí, včetně akcí zastrašování, omezení, donucování, diskriminace, trestních a/nebo disciplinárních opatření' proti Weirovi. Weirův právník Christopher Brizzolara požaduje hospodářské a nehospodářské náhrady za svého klienta, který utrpěl škodu na své policejní kariéře a emoční stres. Houstonová byla naposledy viděna naživu svou osobní asistentkou v pokoji Beverly Hilton asi v 15:00 v sobotu, uvádí pitevní zpráva. Asistentka odešla vykonat úkoly poté, co řekla Houstonové, aby si lehla do vany v přípravě na předávání cen Grammy večer v hotelu, uvádí se. Když se asistentka vrátila do zamčeného pokoje v 15:35, našla Houstonovou 'ležet tváří dolů ve vaně plné vody, neodpovídající.' 'Asistentka zavolala bodyguarda a společně vytáhli zesnulou z vany,' uvádí zpráva. Když záchranáři dorazili asi o deset minut později, přesunuli Houstonovou na podlahu obývacího pokoje. V 15:55, dvacet minut poté, co ji asistentka našla, záchranáři uzavřeli, že je mrtvá, uvádí zpráva. Houstonová vyhrála šest cen Grammy a prodala 170 milionů alb, singlů a videí během své kariéry. V posledních letech byly její úspěchy zastíněny jejím bojem s drogovou závislostí. K reportáži přispěli Rachel Wells a Jennifer Wolfe z CNN.
